english.title: Use a Midland Metro ticket / travel pass / official authority outside the applicable time constraint
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made use of

(A)_[a ticket]_
(B)_[a travel pass]_
(C)_[an official authority]_

to travel on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), outside the time constraints applicable to the fare paid other than to the extent authorised by the conditions of carriage
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(9) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
